english: Yeah, a case. No time to talk!
I see. Good work. Keep at it.
Seen my daughter? The tomboy firefighter.\fNight patrol, with no thought for her poor dad...\fReally... Who does she take after...?
In a hurry. I'll let you off.
Not suspicious! Really, I've done nothing wrong!
What are all the Shinsengumi doing?
Oh no... My makeup's coming off.\fCan't let them see my bare face.\fAnyone who sees it...\fWhat shall I do...?
Always busy. You need a break too.
Right... Our town's peace rests on you. Keep at it.
Too bad... You could get rich...
Still can't find him. Can't work like this!
No, not a joke. Seriously. Not lying.
What?! A leader without followers? So uncool!
A pig...? Now there's another weird one.
It's fine. He's human. Don't worry.
Really! Saw a gorilla AND a pig!
The gorilla?! What happened to it?!
............\fHuh?! Blacked out for a second... Saw something awful...
Yeah. Find him and bring him back. Fast.
No need to worry. Kondo's harmless.
Right. I'll put it to good use.
Poor Commander Kondo, mistaken for a gorilla...\fThough with those looks, understandable.\fOops... Just a joke! Hahaha...
Glad you found your commander safely.
Use my Gin Tama, if you'd like.
Not Shinsengumi, but I hate evil too.
Know where that gorilla-like man went?
No, thanks. Complicated. Don't want to trouble you.
Can't help it, then. Good luck.
Want a Gin Tama battle with me?
Fighting different people gives you experience...
All right... Tell me when you want a battle.
Collect Gin Tama and try again.
Play kick the can with me?
Work. Sorry, no time for you.
My, a handsome man... How about...\fSome squats together?
Damn... Missed out on Jump AGAIN!\fI know who bought the last one before me!\fThat bastard! Unforgivable!
My dad's playing kick the can.
If Dad asks, play kick the can with him.
Please. If Dad asks, play with him.
Piles feel fine tonight. A bleeding bargain!
Oh no... My piles...!\fO-ow...!\fMight REALLY be bleeding...
Nothing... I'm in a hurry... I'll go...
Idiot! Of course I object! What are you doing, sneaking about?!
Looked suspicious... Turns out it WAS!
An Amanto prince meeting a Joi rebel...\fDon't tell me it's just Gin Tama trading.
Quiet, idiot prince! Now, Zura. Answer.
Let's settle this with a Gin Tama battle!
Yes, trading! He'll buy my collection at fifty percent over market price!
You called me an idiot! At least add PRINCE!
What about Dragon Tama and getting rich?
A job? What kind? Ironing wrinkles? Rejuvenation treatments?
...Gintoki. I told you not to get involved.
Can't tell you yet. No... Can't drag you into this!
I win. Now pay every penny you owe.
Then quit loafing around in broad daylight! Go find work!
Say what you like! Pay every penny!
Fine. If I win, pay all the rent you owe.
Someone else unexpected... Or right where they belong...
...Those old bonds are what matter most!
As you know, Katsura, Gin's an idiot!
Now, now, Otose. What brings you here?
Otose, could you wait a little longer?
Rooms from the left. In order!
Came for fireworks. Found a gorilla playing with fire.
No time to hesitate. What now?
What IS it with you people?!
We wouldn't do what you're imagining!
Relax, Captain. I'd never betray my fans... yogurt!
I know. Tch! Zura! Whatever you're plotting, no secrets from me!\fHey! Zura! I know you're in here!
